findings.claim: Immediate selection evidence and descendant survival credit disagree in sign for the same landmark-00 local descriptors: survival enrichment z is negative for local_cxx (z=-0.32, q=0.30) and local_cyy (z=-0.25, q=0.30) while the soft-mass occupancy feature is positive (z=+0.37, q=0.12). Because no survival test survives BH correction (all q>0.05), the disagreement is not resolved by multiplicity-adjusted support and should lower, not raise, priority for these local-shape directions.

The actual later-label calculation is terminal-credit mining over 14 complete-survival batches with BH applied jointly over 400 survival field/measure tests, and it is explicitly not a terminal affinity effect. Ancestral coverage is thin: 349 of 700 batch nodes have fewer than 3 ancestors and 531 have fewer than 6, with at most 2 teachers per batch, so last-record survival credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.

The information audit shows the compressed-choice excess fixed-frame RMS is small (mean 0.081 A, CI95 0.070-0.092) and the chosen-teacher score correlation is weak (compressed 0.102, full 0.064), with top4 teacher overlap only 0.47. This indicates the selection signal is a weak, non-causal geometric proxy rather than a validated affinity predictor, so point-estimate ranking alone would overstate coordinate hypotheses.

Curve support is restricted to 24 selected features under a strict rule (|integrated z|>=0.1, batch direction fraction>=0.857, q<0.05) with a fidelity rule requiring relative RMSE<=0.35 and zero strong sign-conflict nodes; the fidelity audit is a container summary only and its numeric contents were not read, so no claim about individual contrast-curve sign changes or rate changes can be made from this evidence.

The declared objective is final predicted target affinity primary with validity and strain secondary under coordinate-only control, and the score clock covers observed score times 0.00-0.49 within a 0.0-0.5 learning window; recorded affinities are removed and an equal score prior is used, so no observed affinity outcome is available to either role.

hypotheses.direction: increase landmark-00 soft-mass occupancy weight; do not add local_cxx/local_cyy directional terms
hypotheses.falsifier: a batch-level sign reversal or q>=0.05 for the occupancy feature after multiplicity adjustment, or a strong sign conflict in the corresponding contrast curve
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00_soft_mass survival enrichment z and its batch direction fraction
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned regional attention rule that up-weights landmark-00 soft-mass occupancy while leaving local_cxx/local_cyy directions free may improve coordinate contrast relative to a constant rule, because the only positive survival signal is the occupancy feature and the local-shape directions are negative or null.

hypotheses.direction: rank by batch agreement and ancestral coverage rather than point estimate
hypotheses.falsifier: a feature with high point estimate but low batch agreement that still reproduces a positive effect in held-out batches
hypotheses.statement: Because the chosen-teacher score correlation is weak and the excess fixed-frame RMS is small, a coordinate rule that prioritizes point-estimate magnitude alone is not supported; a rule conditioned on independent-batch agreement and coverage would rank hypotheses differently.

limitations: No decoded terminal labels are supplied, so last-record survival credit cannot be compared with final affinity benefit; that comparison is unavailable.
The curve fidelity audit is a container summary only; individual contrast-curve sign changes, fit fidelity and rate changes were not read and are not claimed.

Survival, increment and endpoint effect tables were only partially read (first rows of survival_effects); no multiplicity-adjusted ranking across all 400 survival and 74 increment/endpoint tests is asserted.
The information audit metrics are geometric proxies, not the full score-weighted reward or its FLOWR Jacobian, and are not causal affinity effects.
No current study outcome data are available to the Analyst role.
